voices.title: Sheila
voices.description: A young American English woman's voice.

voices.title: Megan
voices.description: A London Estuary-accented English woman voice, in her late twenties. Warm, friendly, relaxed. Best suited to conversational use.

voices.title: Gareth
voices.description: An Australian-accented English man's voice, in his mid-fifties. Deep, authoritative, storytelling. A seasoned bushwalker and nature photographer from Perth. Best suited to audiobooks, documentaries and long-form narration.

voices.title: Rohan
voices.description: A natural, professional Indian English voice with a brisk, conversational pace. Clear and easy to follow, suited to voice assistants, customer support and everyday narration.

voices.title: Cathal
voices.description: An Irish-accented English man's voice, in his mid-forties. Warm, professional, gentle. A dependable hardware store owner from Limerick. Best suited to customer support and voice assistants.
